title: “With You I Learned to Do Politics”: Lula Remembers Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas
author: Blanche Petrich
content:
_This article by[Blanche
Petrich](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Blanche%20Petrich) originally
appeared in the [October 31, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/31/politica/contigo-
aprendi-a-hacer-politica-lula-recuerda-a-cuauhtemoc-cardenas), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

It was 1979. At a university in Houston, Texas, the young Brazilian union
leader Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who was beginning to stand out in politics
and to promote internationally the foundations of the PT (then in its
infancy), was speaking before a packed auditorium. But the interpreter did not
speak Portuguese well, nor did Lula speak English. The talk was about to
founder when a tall, brown-skinned man stood up from the audience. "I'll
translate," he offered. "**It was none other than compañero Cuauhtémoc
Cárdenas** ," Lula recalled.

From that encounter, more than 40 years ago, a strong friendship was born
between the two politicians. In May 2024, on the occasion of the 90th birthday
of engineer Cárdenas Solórzano, the UNAM organized a tribute celebration in
which a video message from President Lula was broadcast, in which he shared
that small story that would mark a strong, lifelong relationship.

"I feel very proud to have chosen you as a compañero, Cárdenas, because **with
you I learned to do politics, I learned solidarity, I learned respect** ," the
veteran Brazilian leader said, visibly moved.

According to Lula, his great Mexican friend still had to last 10 more years,
since the Brazilian leader, who was 78 years old at the time, hoped that
Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas would live to 102 so he could return the gesture and also
send him a 90th birthday greeting. "Because you know," he reminded him, "that
I want to live to 120."

The brief video message is a tribute to friendship:

> We cannot choose our brothers, we are simply children of a father and a
> mother. But a friend, we choose. And I have had the joy of living this
> relationship of friendship with the engineer for many years. Rarely have I
> known a man so coherent, so serious, so decent and honest in his commitments
> to democracy and to humanity's quality of life.
>
> Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva

On that occasion he also recalled with sorrow **the theft of Cárdenas 's
electoral victory in the 1988 presidential election**. "Who knows if the
history of Mexico could have been much better." He also recalled that Cárdenas
was one of the very few politicians in the world who left his country to
travel to Brazil and **visit him in the prison in Curitiba** , Paraná, where
he was incarcerated between 2018 and 2019.
